title: 第990章 大阵不可轻开第989章 帮我带个话
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
秦怀安来到紫荆山脉中央的时候，看着眼前笼罩紫天峰及周边几个山峰的护山大阵，不禁唏嘘不已。
距离秦怀安当初离开紫天峰已经过去四百年的时间，他离开的时候还只是初入渡劫期。四百年的时间，山峦依旧，可紫荆大陆早已不是曾经的紫荆大陆了。
当初紫荆大陆的那些大宗门，大部分都已经消失不见，不是被灭，就是加入外来的那些大势力。
紫天、紫云、紫光三大圣地合一之后的紫荆圣地，此时也只能依靠这个强大的护山大阵苦苦支撑。
现在的紫天峰，已经改名为了紫荆峰，同样也变成了合并之后的紫荆圣地主峰。
尽管有这个大阵的存在，紫荆圣地在这个护山大阵之下还能支撑一段时间；但是，等到紫荆大世界的的其他宗门的阵法水平提高之后，这个护山大阵就很难再像现在这样保护紫荆圣地的安全了。
秦怀安围着这个护山大阵转了一圈，发现这个阵法水平极高，是一座最顶级的六阶仙阵。现在的他，想要破解这个阵法，恐怕就算全力施展太虚圣灭，也无法将其攻破。
没想到，紫荆圣地竟然还有如此强大的阵法流传下来。
不过，这个阵法也隔绝了他对于紫荆峰的窥探，他现在也无法把自己的消息传递进入这个护山大阵。
当然，秦怀安不着急。他知道，护山大阵内部的人，是肯定可以看到外面情况的，只要那些紫荆圣地的弟子看到秦怀安，定然可以认出他来。
毕竟，秦怀安的名头，数百年前就已经闻名整个紫荆域了。何况是紫天圣地还有大量弟子是认识秦怀安的。
秦怀安并不着急，现在刚刚把天宝圣地赶出紫荆山脉，其他几大宗门也都已经承诺很快就退出紫荆山脉。
现在的紫荆山脉没人敢过来造次。当然，段临川除外。
不过，段临川距离到达紫荆大陆至少还有一个月时间。
......
紫荆圣地内部。
道玄真人和其大弟子明泽正在大殿中相对而坐。
“师尊，我们的护山大阵坚固无比，您无需担心。除了长风师兄，现在您是我紫荆圣地最强大的存在，您闭关修炼提升越多，我紫荆圣地就越有希望。”明泽说道。
“呵呵，明泽，我刚刚突破都仙尊中期境界百年左右，我的资质不如你长风师叔和你二师妹。如果不是那枚道果，我距离仙尊中期不知还要修炼多少年。”
“想要再进一步，修炼到仙尊后期，恐怕要以万年甚至十万年为单位了。”

“所以，我现在就算一直闭关修炼，也很难有所提升。索性就把更多的精力，放在教导弟子身上。”
“我们现在紫荆圣地的资源，最多坚持再坚持两千多年的时间。”
“到时候，如果还没找到解决天宝圣地威胁的方法，那我们只能悄悄疏散弟子了。”
“所以，我紫荆圣地的子弟修为越高，以后能够逃脱的概率就越高。”
content_en:
When Qin Huaian came to the center of the Zijin Mountains, he couldn't help but sigh when he looked at the mountain protection formation covering Zitian Peak and several surrounding peaks.
Four hundred years have passed since Qin Huaian left Zitian Peak. When he left, he was still in the stage of transcending the tribulation. Four hundred years later, the mountains remain the same, but the Bauhinia Continent is no longer the Bauhinia Continent it once was.
Most of the big sects in the Bauhinia Continent have disappeared, either destroyed or joining the big foreign forces.
After the three holy lands of Zitian, Ziyun, and Ziguang merged into one, the Bauhinia Holy Land could only rely on this powerful mountain-protecting formation to support itself.
The current Zitian Peak has been renamed Bauhinia Peak, and has also become the main peak of the Bauhinia Holy Land after the merger.
Despite the existence of this formation, the Bauhinia Holy Land can still support the Bauhinia Holy Land for some time under this mountain-protecting formation; however, when the formation level of other sects in the Bauhinia World improves, it will be difficult for this mountain-protecting formation to protect the security of the Bauhinia Holy Land as it does now.
Qin Huaian walked around the mountain-protecting formation and found that this formation was of extremely high level and was a top-notch sixth-level immortal formation. Now, if he wants to break this formation, he may not be able to break it even if he uses Taixu Holy Destruction with all his strength.
Unexpectedly, such a powerful formation has been handed down in the Bauhinia Holy Land.
However, this formation also blocked his prying eyes on Bauhinia Peak, and he was now unable to pass his message into this mountain-protecting formation.
Of course, Qin Huaian is not in a hurry. He knew that people inside the mountain-protecting formation could definitely see what was going on outside. As long as those disciples of the Bauhinia Holy Land saw Qin Huaian, they would definitely be able to recognize him.
After all, Qin Huaian's name has been famous throughout the Bauhinia Territory hundreds of years ago. What's more, there are a large number of disciples in Zitian Holy Land who know Qin Huaian.
Qin Huaian is not in a hurry. He has just driven Tianbao Holy Land out of the Bauhinia Mountains, and several other major sects have also promised to withdraw from the Bauhinia Mountains soon.
No one in the current Bauhinia Mountains dares to come and make trouble. Of course, except Duan Linchuan.
However, Duan Linchuan still has at least a month before reaching Bauhinia Continent.
...
Inside the Redbud Holy Land.
Master Daoxuan and his eldest disciple Mingze were sitting opposite each other in the main hall.
"Master, our mountain-protecting formation is extremely strong. You don't need to worry. Apart from Senior Brother Changfeng, you are now the most powerful being in our Bauhinia Holy Land. The more you improve in seclusion and practice, the more hopeful our Bauhinia Holy Land will be," Mingze said.
"Haha, Mingze, I just broke through the middle stage of Duxianzun for about a hundred years, and my qualifications are not as good as your Uncle Changfeng and your second junior sister. If it weren't for that Dao Fruit, I don't know how many more years of cultivation I would have to be before I could reach the middle stage of Duxianzun."
"If you want to go further and cultivate to the late stage of Immortal Lord, I am afraid it will take ten thousand or even one hundred thousand years as a unit."
"So, even if I keep practicing in seclusion, it will be difficult for me to improve. I just put more energy on teaching my disciples."
"With the resources we have in the Redbud Holy Land, we can last for another two thousand years at most."
"By then, if we haven't found a way to solve the threat to Tianbao Holy Land, then we can only quietly evacuate the disciples."
"Therefore, the higher the cultivation level of my disciples in Bauhinia Holy Land, the higher the probability of being able to escape in the future."
